info.name: Coveo Activity Activities Query Configurations API
info.description:
API for Coveo Platform

Contact Support:
 Name: Coveo

item.name: Get Query Configuration for a Solution

query.description: (Required) The unique identifier of the tracking target.
(Required) The solution type for the rule. It can be either 'listing' or 'search' or 'recommendations'.
List of target identifiers e.g. listing page name, slot ID
Whether the query configuration is globally applied.

variable.description:
(Required) The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `acmecorporation8tp8wu3`

request.description:
Retrieves the query configuration for a solution (e.g. listing, search) in an [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

Note: When using the Recommendation solution type, only the `perPage` and `additionalFields` parameters within the query configuration model are supported.

**Required privilege:** Merchandising Hub - View

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"COMMERCE","targetDomain":"MERCHANDISING_HUB","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```
